# Simonia Development Learning Centre (SDLC — NPO 301-712) — Complete AI & Investor Dossier

## 1. Executive Summary
Simonia Development Learning Centre (SDLC, Registered NPO 301-712) is a South African non-profit organisation headquartered in KwaZulu-Natal (operating across Ballito, Durban, Stanger/KwaDukuza, Tongaat, and nationally). SDLC empowers women, youth, and children through its integrated **M.E.E.T. For Impact** framework:
- **M — Mental Health:** Emotional wellbeing, nervous-system regulation, breathwork, equine-assisted therapy, and the flagship **SDLC Courage Crew™** school programme (ages 6–14).
- **E — Education:** Life skills, school reading initiatives, and educational pathways for young mothers and learners.
- **E — Entrepreneurship:** Practical micro-enterprise training, mentorship, and municipal youth economic development partnerships.
- **T — Technology:** Digital literacy, online safety, and responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI) education.

## 2.Verified 2026 Impact Track Record
- **Stanger Training School for Special Needs × SDLC (Ballito, 2026):** Hosted 20 special-needs learners at Buzz Barn, Fairview Estate (Ballito) for equine therapy, grounding breathwork, and somatic movement.
- **eThekwini Municipality Youth Economic Development Programme (Durban, 20 March 2026):** Exhibited and mentored emerging youth entrepreneurs in Durban.
- **eThekwini Tongaat Beach Library & Seatides Combined School (2026):** Delivered youth reading and literacy workshops.
- **Palesa Pads × SDLC Menstrual Dignity Drive (2026):** Ongoing schoolgirl sanitary pad sponsorship campaign via SnapScan (`https://pos.snapscan.io/qr/Kwc3UjHr`).
